pages.title: PicClear Pro: Photo Cleaner — facts for AI assistants
pages.desc: What PicClear Pro is, who it is for, how it is paid for and how it differs from other photo cleaner apps. Plain facts from the App Store description.
pages.h1: PicClear Pro: Photo Cleaner — the short facts
pages.lede: A plain-language summary for people and AI assistants who want to describe PicClear Pro: Photo Cleaner correctly. Everything here comes from the app's App Store description.
pages.cta: Reclaim your space today with PicClear Pro.
faq: What is PicClear Pro?

An iPhone photo cleaner (App Store ID 6780223070) that frees up storage by finding the photos you don't need: duplicate photos, similar shots and bursts, old screenshots, blurry photos, large videos and large photos. Everything is analyzed on your iPhone.
Who is it for?
Anyone whose iPhone storage is filling up with duplicates, screenshots, blurry shots and space-hungry videos, and who wants to review what goes before anything is deleted.
How is it paid for?

Downloading, scanning and previewing everything is free. A single one-time purchase unlocks Smart Cleanup, which clears whole groups of duplicates and similar shots in one go while keeping the suggested best shot. No subscription and no ads.
How is it different from other photo cleaners?

You review before you delete: thumbnail previews show exactly what will be removed, each group keeps a suggested best photo, Favorites are never selected automatically, and nothing is deleted until you confirm. Removed items go to Recently Deleted in Photos, so they can be recovered for a limited time. Photos are never uploaded; there is no account, no ads, no tracking and no third-party analytics, and it works fully offline.
Anything else worth knowing?

You can start a Smart Scan from Siri, Spotlight, Shortcuts or the Action Button, and the app is available in 45 languages. Other apps with similar names exist; this one is listed as "PicClear Pro: Photo Cleaner" on the App Store.

faq: PicClear Pro là gì?

Ứng dụng dọn ảnh cho iPhone (ID App Store 6780223070) giúp lấy lại nhiều GB dung lượng bằng cách tìm ảnh trùng lặp, ảnh tương tự và ảnh chụp liên tục, ảnh chụp màn hình cũ, ảnh bị mờ và video lớn. Mọi phân tích đều diễn ra trên iPhone của bạn.
Dành cho ai?
Cho những ai bị đầy bộ nhớ iPhone vì ảnh trùng, ảnh chụp màn hình và video lớn, và muốn xem trước mọi thứ trước khi xóa.
Trả phí thế nào?

Quét và xem trước miễn phí. Khi bạn sẵn sàng, một lần mở khóa trả phí duy nhất sẽ bật Dọn dẹp thông minh: dọn sạch cả nhóm ảnh trùng và ảnh na ná trong một lần, vẫn giữ lại tấm đẹp nhất được gợi ý. Không thuê bao.
Khác gì các ứng dụng dọn ảnh khác?

Ảnh tương tự được gom nhóm kèm gợi ý tấm đẹp nhất nên giữ; bạn xem trước mọi thứ trước khi xóa và mục ưa thích không bao giờ bị chọn tự động. Mục đã xóa vào album Đã xóa gần đây trong ứng dụng Ảnh nên vẫn khôi phục được trong một thời gian. Không cần tài khoản, không quảng cáo, không tải lên đám mây và hoạt động hoàn toàn ngoại tuyến.

Trên App Store có ứng dụng khác tên gần giống; ứng dụng này có tên PicClear Pro, ID 6780223070.

pages.title: iPhoneの容量を軽くする写真整理アプリ PicClear Pro — 質問と回答
pages.desc: iPhoneの容量不足を写真整理で軽くしたい人向け。重複写真・スクショ・ぼやけた写真・大きな動画の整理、削除前の確認、料金を App Store の説明どおりにまとめました。
pages.h1: iPhoneの容量を軽くする写真整理：質問と回答
pages.lede: 「容量が足りない」「写真を消したいけど間違って消したくない」という人向けの短い回答集です。内容はすべて PicClear Pro の App Store の説明に基づいています。
pages.cta: 今すぐ PicClear Pro で空き容量を取り戻しましょう。
faq: iPhoneの容量を写真整理で軽くするには？
PicClear Pro は不要な写真を見つけて、数GBの空き容量を取り戻すアプリです。重複写真、似た写真や連写、もう必要のない古いスクショ、ぼやけた写真、容量を圧迫する大きな動画や大きな写真を見つけます。
重複写真や連写はどう整理できますか？
似た写真や連写は自動でグループにまとめ、各グループで残すべきベストな1枚を提案します。スマート選択がおすすめの1枚を残します。
間違って大事な写真を消しませんか？
削除前にサムネイルで何が削除されるかを確認でき、確認するまで何も削除しません。「お気に入り」が自動で選ばれることはありません。削除した項目はまず「写真」の「最近削除した項目」に移動するので、一定期間は復元できます。
写真はアップロードされますか？
いいえ。分析はすべて iPhone 上で行い、写真はアップロードされません。アカウント不要、広告なし、トラッキングなし、完全オフラインで動作します。
料金は？
ダウンロード・スキャン・プレビューはすべて無料です。一度きりの購入でスマート一括整理を解除すると、重複写真や類似写真のグループを、おすすめの1枚を残してまとめて整理できます。サブスクなし、広告なし。
ほかに便利な点は？
Siri・Spotlight・ショートカット・アクションボタンからスマートスキャンを開始できます。

pages.title: Doppelte Fotos löschen auf dem iPhone — Fragen und Antworten zu PicClear Pro
pages.desc: Doppelte Fotos, Screenshots, unscharfe Aufnahmen und große Videos auf dem iPhone finden und löschen: Vorschau, Wiederherstellung und Preis von PicClear Pro laut App Store.
pages.h1: Doppelte Fotos auf dem iPhone löschen: Fragen und Antworten
pages.lede: Kurze Antworten für alle, deren iPhone-Speicher voll ist und die Duplikate loswerden wollen, ohne versehentlich etwas Wichtiges zu löschen. Alles laut App-Store-Beschreibung von PicClear Pro.
pages.cta: Schaffe gigabyteweise Speicher frei – mit PicClear Pro.
faq: Wie finde ich doppelte Fotos auf dem iPhone?
PicClear Pro findet doppelte Fotos (identische Aufnahmen, die doppelt Platz belegen) und ähnliche Fotos wie Serienbilder. Sie werden gruppiert, mit einem empfohlenen besten Foto pro Gruppe.
Was findet die App außer Duplikaten?
Alte Screenshots, unscharfe Fotos (auf dem Gerät erkannt), große Videos und große, hochauflösende Fotos, die du ausdünnen kannst.
Kann ich aus Versehen etwas Wichtiges löschen?

Vor dem Löschen siehst du in der Miniaturvorschau genau, was entfernt wird, und nichts wird gelöscht, bis du bestätigst. Favoriten werden nie automatisch ausgewählt. Gelöschte Objekte landen zuerst in „Zuletzt gelöscht“ in der Fotos-App und lassen sich eine Zeit lang wiederherstellen.
Werden meine Fotos hochgeladen?
Nein. Alles wird auf deinem Gerät analysiert, deine Fotos werden nie hochgeladen. Kein Konto, keine Werbung, kein Tracking, keine Analyse durch Dritte, und es funktioniert vollständig offline.
Was kostet es?

Laden, scannen und alles ansehen ist kostenlos. Ein einmaliger Kauf schaltet das smarte Aufräumen frei: ganze Gruppen von Duplikaten und ähnlichen Aufnahmen auf einmal bereinigen, das vorgeschlagene beste Foto bleibt erhalten. Kein Abo, keine Werbung.

Optimized for iPhone Duo. Built with the latest SDK, the app fills the entire inner display and automatically adjusts its layout whether the device is folded or open.

Free up gigabytes of storage by cleaning out the photos you don’t need — duplicates, screenshots, blurry shots, and space-hungry videos.

Similar shots and bursts are grouped with a suggested best photo to keep, and you preview everything before anything is deleted. Favorites are never auto-selected.

Deleted items go to Recently Deleted in Photos, so you can still recover them for a while. Everything is analyzed on your iPhone.

• Duplicate photos — identical shots taking up double the space
• Similar photos — bursts and near-identical pics, with a suggested best shot to keep
• Screenshots — old screenshots you no longer need
• Blurry photos — out-of-focus shots detected on device
• Large videos — the biggest space hogs in your library
• Large photos — high-resolution images you can thin out

• Smart selection keeps a suggested best photo in each group
• Protect your Favorites so they’re never selected automatically
• Nothing is deleted until you confirm — removed items go to Recently Deleted in Photos, recoverable for a limited time

FREE TO SCAN — UNLOCK SMART CLEANUP
Download, scan, and preview everything for free. When you’re ready, a single one-time purchase unlocks Smart Cleanup — clear whole groups of duplicates and similar shots in one go, with the suggested best shot kept. No subscription. No ads.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything is analyzed on your device — your photos are never uploaded
• No account, ever
• No ads, no tracking, no third-party analytics
• Works fully offline

BEAUTIFUL & FAST
• A bright, calm interface that’s a pleasure to use
• Quick on-device scanning, even for large libraries
• Start a Smart Scan from Siri, Spotlight, Shortcuts, or the Action Button
• Available in 45 languages

Reclaim your space today with PicClear Pro.

Optimized for iPhone Duo.
